promotion.definition: All method/learner/dataset scopes are reported. Practical confirmation candidates need >=5% mean seed relative cost reduction vs independently tuned same-kernel baseline, >=7/10 strict seed wins, recall change>=-0.02 and balanced accuracy>=0.55. Corrected95%CI/rawp/Holm across all confirmation scopes are reported separately; statistical support is not claimed merely by promotion. Families ranked first by number of Holm<0.05 scopes then source-balanced mean improvement; at most4 families advance, both learners and all4 datasets/10seeds, not only favorable scopes.

cost: 5FN+FP primary. Secondary2FN+FP and10FN+FP keep the5:1-selected fitted model and hyperparameters fixed, retune only the exact margin threshold on validation before test access. This is fixed-model cost-ratio sensitivity, not independently optimized cost-ratio-specific model selection. Never choose cost ratio on test.
split: Within this campaign fix stratified test10% once per dataset, anchor20261018+dataset offset0/1/2/3. All10seeds2010..2100 split the remaining90% into train80/validation10. Thus no final-test customer occurs in ANY seed's smoke/training/model-family selection. Inside each training80, stratified75/12.5/12.5 gives inner-fit/tune/confirmation. Discovery uses3seeds/cap768 and inner-tune only. Confirmation uses10seeds/cap2048 and locks choices before inner-confirmation labels. Refit every encoding/scaler/PCA/OOF LR only on actual fit rows. German Numeric is evaluated as a related-encoding sensitivity only and is excluded from ALL family ranking/promotion statistics, because record alignment with South German is not certified; South German/Taiwan/HMEQ are the three primary source families. New anchor/seeds do not erase earlier exploratory reuse of these datasets.
selection: Full model search uses every outer-training row, all positive0.05 lambdas, common3C and3geometries. Up to4096rows search kernels are exact SVC. Above4096, a standard train-only stratified512-landmark Nystrom factorization with float64 eigh and LinearSVC is a declared parameter-selection surrogate. Positive lambda/geometry/C and separate no-risk choice are locked on outer-validation cost before exact fitting. Final large-data models are exact precomputed-kernel SVC fitted once on all80% with locked parameters; exact validation margins get their own fresh threshold, never transfer an approximate threshold. Smaller exact-search models reuse the same fit margins. All final choices/thresholds across methods are locked before reading any outer-test labels. No SVM ensemble or refit after final exact threshold selection.
ablations: Full normal/shuffled/constant for risk methods, normal/shuffled-training-label metric controls for purely supervised embedding methods, and no-entangling Z-map controls for QSVC. Each control is selected independently on validation. Training uses correct labels for final SVM in every arm. Baseline lambda0 and positive-only proposed are distinct. Also compare independently tuned same-kernel baseline, raw-feature LR/RF/XGBoost and shared-PCA risk controls. Classical circuit-analog methods are explicit controls, not claimed identical quantum circuits.
statistics: Full uses a common fixed test cohort: never treat10training seeds as10independent test samples. For each customer average loss differences across10separately fitted single models, without averaging predictions. Stratified customer-cluster bootstrap5000replicates supplies95%CI; paired customer-cluster sign-flip19999replicates supplies two-sided MonteCarlo p under paired exchangeability. Intervals are conditional on development data, fitted models and stratified test prevalence, not all training-data uncertainty. Primary contrasts: own-no-risk, independently tuned same-kernel baseline, validation-selected classical reference, shuffled/constant where defined, separable quantum, Q-minus-RBF risk gain. Holm over all planned scopes; incomplete tests retainp=1 and remain not estimable. All10seeds required. German Numeric is labelled related-encoding exploratory sensitivity, not independent confirmatory evidence. Cost-ratio2/10 fixed-model threshold sensitivity has a separate paired-customer Holm family. Lambda profiles are descriptive only (exact search for small data, approximate search for large data), not dependent-seed significance tests. Smoke corrected-holdout p-values are selection diagnostics, not final evidence; ranking excludes German Numeric including its multiplicity influence.
